key_idea: Look at each number and check if it is in the square or not.
steps: Outside the square are 7 at the top, 2 on the left, 5 on the right and 9 at the bottom.
So 4 numbers are outside the square.

choice_feedback.A: There is a number outside on every side: top, left, right and bottom.
choice_feedback.B: Look on all 4 sides of the square. There is one number on each side.
choice_feedback.C: 5 is how many numbers are inside the square.
choice_feedback.E: Only 4 numbers are outside. The other 5 are inside.
